title: Symbol-U Assistant Utility — Metrics definitions (frozen)
description: Frozen metric definitions rated per response. Primary = overall usefulness. All quality metrics on an integer 1-5 scale (higher better). Overinterpretation is a PENALTY captured as flagged instances with severity, combined into net usefulness by the preregistered rule.

definition.const: how genuinely useful the response is to this user in this situation, all things considered

secondary.description: rated independently of the primary and of each other

default.definition: correctly grasps what the user actually said/meant
appropriately attuned to the user's emotional state
goes beneath the surface where warranted (not padding)
offers usable next steps or framing the user can act on
offers a genuinely helpful alternative perspective
respects the user's stated intent and autonomy; does not override it
refrains from asserting things not supported by the user's message

composite_rule.const: net_usefulness = overall_usefulness - sum(overinterpretation weights), floored at 1; reported ALONGSIDE raw usefulness, never replacing it
